verdict.rationale: Notion's API/webhook docs show engineers can subscribe to real-time events (page/property/comment changes) and use personal access tokens or OAuth connections to script automated actions, which supports building custom trigger-and-action workflows, but this requires external code/services rather than a native built-in automation rule builder, and no evidence describes an out-of-the-box UI for creating trigger-action rules. missing for 10: evidence of a native no-code automation/rules engine, end-to-end example of a working automation, independent confirmation of reliability.
